Judah Lewis is an American actor born on May 22, 2001 (or 2000 - sources vary slightly on his birth year). He's best known for his work in horror-comedy films and has built a reputation as a talented young actor in the genre.

**Notable Film Roles:**
- **"The Babysitter" (2017)** and **"The Babysitter: Killer Queen" (2020)** - His breakout role as Cole Johnson in these Netflix horror-comedy films directed by McG
- **"Demolition" (2016)** - Appeared alongside Jake Gyllenhaal
- **"Deliverance Creek" (2014)** - A Lifetime movie that was one of his early roles
- **"Summer of 84" (2018)** - A horror-thriller where he played Davey Armstrong

**Other Work:**
- Has appeared in some television projects
- Known for doing his own stunts when possible
- Has worked with several notable directors and actors early in his career

**Personal Life:**
- Relatively private about his personal life
- Active on social media platforms
- Has expressed interest in continuing to work in both horror and other genres

He's considered one of the promising young actors of his generation, particularly in the horror-comedy genre, and has received praise for his natural acting ability and on-screen charisma. His performance in "The Babysitter" films particularly garnered him a fan following.
